title: fix(service-storage): forward the caller's execution envelope to the sys_attachment sharing gates (#7145)
body:
Fixes #7145

Mirrors merged PR #7143 (#7141) into `service-storage`: `callerContext()` in
`packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-access-hooks.ts` rebuilt the
identical five-field projection of the caller's execution envelope
(`userId` / `tenantId` / `positions` / `permissions` / `isSystem`) before handing
it to `ISharingService.canEdit`, whose contract declares the **full** envelope and
whose doc block tells callers they "MUST NOT rebuild a subset of it" (#6523 / the
#6206 ruling). The attachment kit is what the comment kit was derived from, so the
defect is the same one, one package over.

## Premise check at `origin/main`

Verified at `aeadbd61c` (worktree branched from it), not from a working tree:

- The five-field projection is verbatim live at `attachment-access-hooks.ts:71-84`.
- Two `sharing.canEdit(parentObject, …, callerContext(ctx))` sites: the
  `beforeInsert` parent gate (line 118) and the `beforeDelete` per-row
  authorization loop (line 201).
- `security-plugin.ts:707` — `if (context?.onBehalfOf?.userId) return false;` (the
  documented fail-CLOSED bypass guard).
- `security-plugin.ts:3024` — `const isAgent = context?.principalKind === 'agent';`
  (the ADR-0090 D10 ceiling rule).
- `runtime/src/security/resolve-execution-context.ts:191` — the live producer,
  `ctx.onBehalfOf = { userId: authz.userId, principalKind: 'human' };`.
- `sc.__readScope` / `__delegatorReadScope` / `__writeScope` / `__delegatorWriteScope`
  stamped in place at `security-plugin.ts:1159-1173`; `__expandRead` in
  `objectql/src/engine.ts`, `__referentialFieldClear` in the engine and
  `security-plugin.ts:1508`.

Premise holds; nothing had landed this mirror.

## What changed

`withoutOperationPrivateKeys()` — the same helper shape #7143 landed — replaces the
projection. The envelope is forwarded whole, minus keys carrying the `__` **prefix**.

- **The middleware-key strip is the half that was correct, and it survives.**
  plugin-security stamps the access DEPTH it resolved for the object of the
  operation in flight (`sys_attachment`) onto the context in place, while these
  gates ask the sharing service about the **parent record's** object. Carrying
  those across is one object's widening applied to another object's question.
  Dropped by prefix rather than by a name list, so a fifth stamped key cannot go
  stale.
- **The principal-field drop was the defect.** `onBehalfOf` re-arms the
  fail-closed `hasWriteBypass` guard; `principalKind` stops an ADR-0090 D10 agent
  principal being resolved as a human and gaining the deployment's additive
  baseline on top of its consented ceiling. `systemPermissions`,
  `accessible_org_ids`, `posture`, `audience` and `rlsMembership` ride back for
  the same reason — the envelope is the contract's unit.
- **Both `canEdit` call sites** are covered, since both read the one
  `callerContext()`.
- **Also the read middleware's parent-visibility probe** in the same file
  (`computeParentVisibilityFilter`), which spread the whole operation context into
  a `find` on a *different* object — the same half PR #7143 applied to the comment
  kit's read side. Flagged explicitly because the card's Fact section names only
  `callerContext()`; it is the same rule in the same file and the same defect
  class, so leaving it would land a half mirror.

The `beforeInsert` degraded path (no sharing service → caller-scoped parent
`findOne`) and the session-snapshot fallback are unchanged.

## Relation to #7144 — deliberately NOT changed

No access DEPTH is synthesised for the parent object. Absent depth leaves the
sharing owner-match at its narrowest (`own`), which is the safe direction and
**byte-for-byte what the projection produced**. Resolving the parent's own depth
would WIDEN these gates; that question is #7144's (`needs-user-decision`) and this
PR does not touch it. Per triage 2026-08-09T22:21Z: "Not blocked: the fix keeps
`own`-depth gate behaviour byte-for-byte, so it does not wait on the #7144 depth
decision; note the relation in the PR instead."

## Tests — reverse-verified in BOTH directions

9 new cases in `attachment-access-hooks.test.ts` plus 1 in
`attachment-read-visibility.test.ts`. Following #7143's pattern, the fixture is a
real `/mcp` OAuth agent envelope (`principalKind: 'agent'` + `onBehalfOf`) with the
middleware-private keys riding along, and the sharing/security doubles model the
contract across the seam (service-storage does not depend on plugin-security).

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test` — **23 files, 334 tests, all green.**

**Reverse verification A — restore the pre-fix five-field projection**
(`git checkout origin/main -- attachment-access-hooks.ts`): **6 red**, each in the
predicted direction.

```
x beforeInsert forwards the whole envelope MINUS the operation-private keys
x beforeDelete forwards the whole envelope MINUS the operation-private keys
x REFUSES a delegated principal whose sets carry modifyAllRecords (fail-closed, #7145)
x REFUSES the same delegated principal on the beforeInsert parent gate too
x keeps an AGENT principal capped at its ceiling - no additive human baseline (ADR-0090 D10)
x probes the parent with the caller ENVELOPE, minus the operation-private keys

AssertionError: expected { userId: 'human_1', ...(4) } to deeply equal { userId: 'human_1', ...(12) }
AssertionError: promise resolved "undefined" instead of rejecting        <- the fail-open the card names
AssertionError: expected { userId: 'u1', ...(7) } to not have property "__readScope"
Tests  6 failed | 47 passed (53)
```

**Reverse verification B — keep the forward but delete the strip half** (the
`startsWith(OPERATION_PRIVATE_KEY_PREFIX)` line, i.e. a naive `return exec`):
**8 red** — the same 6 plus the two depth pins, which A cannot exercise because the
old projection dropped the depth too.

```
x does NOT carry sys_attachment's access DEPTH into the parent's owner-match
x does not carry the depth into the beforeInsert parent gate either
AssertionError: expected { userId: 'human_1', ...(17) } to deeply equal { userId: 'human_1', ...(12) }
Tests  8 failed | 45 passed (53)
```

Both halves are therefore pinned: a fix that reopened the middleware-key leak
would go red on B, and the pre-fix code goes red on A. Asserting only "fields are
forwarded" would have passed B.

Two cases are green in both directions and are honest regression pins rather than
defect pins, stated rather than dressed up: "hands the service a COPY" (the old
projection also allocated a fresh object) and "still falls back to the session
snapshot when no execution context rides along".

## Verification run

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-storage^...' build` (dependency closure,
  suffix `^...` — 15 projects) green before any judgement, per the stale-artefact rule.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test` -> 23 files / 334 tests green.
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in the package: **no diagnostics on any file
  this PR touches**. (The package's tsconfig reports pre-existing errors in other,
  untouched test files - `TS2835` missing extensions, `TS2550` lib target - so the
  useful read is the filtered one; the dts build below is the real gate on `src`.)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage build` (tsup + DTS) green.
- Consumer sweep, **downstream prefix direction** `--filter '...@objectstack/service-storage'`:
  7 packages (`cli`, `plugin-dev`, `dogfood`, `example-crm`, `example-showcase`,
  `example-todo`, plus the package itself). The exported surface is unchanged -
  `installAttachmentAccessHooks`, `installAttachmentReadVisibility` and
  `AttachmentSharingLike` all keep their signatures; only the private
  `callerContext()` body and its return annotation changed - so no consumer type
  moved. Verified by building the two publishable consumers after their own
  dependency closures (`--filter '@objectstack/plugin-dev^...' --filter '@objectstack/cli^...'`
  first, then the consumers): both green, exit 0. Building the consumers WITHOUT
  their closures first fails with `TS2307 Cannot find module '@objectstack/rest'`
  and friends - the stale/missing-artefact trap, not this change.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` -> OK; targeted control-byte self-scan over the
  four touched files -> clean.

## Changeset

`.changeset/attachment-gate-caller-envelope.md`, `@objectstack/service-storage`
patch - a security-behaviour fix in a published package.

Enforcement effect: a delegated (`onBehalfOf`-carrying) principal is now refused
where the contract says it is refused. **No caller gains access.**
